snippet.title: Restitched | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Join Stuffy on a daring quest to uncover their origins and "restitch" unraveling communities. Unleash your creativity with a robust 2.5D level editor, play dress up with a mix-and-match Wardrobe, and share your creations via Steam Workshop!

Restitched is a passion-made project by a group of creators worldwide! It's a unique love letter to the user-generated content (UGC) genre and our many amazing experiences within it.

🌟 Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361090/Restitched/

🌟 Learn More: 
https://www.trixelcreative.com/restitched
